name: Files sent between computers
what: An agent sends a file from its computer to another computer with a tool of Silo. The file crosses only where a rule you set allows it: from one named computer to another, one way or both ways, or between the computers of a group.

suggest.why: Agents on several computers need to pass a build or a data file, and a rule you set is the only way that fits a computer never getting more than it has.
